title: Advertised Sepanggar water-shortage demonstration at Sabah water department headquarters, 27 March
exclusion_reason: No actual assembly is reported: the Daily Express rendered result says the anticipated demonstration “did not materialize” and that its reporter waited at two sites without seeing any group. It was a threatened/planned event only, so no protest occurrence to code. This observation applies to this announced action and does not establish absence of demonstrations elsewhere in Sabah.
notes: Search-result evidence only; retained conservatively as a no-occurrence lead, not an exhaustive local check.
